svg.text: Each of the 100 slots gets one isolated workspace. Nothing here touches the Devspace app’s own stack.

g.text: Verified live against the GitHub API.
Original vs. modernized, side by side,
with a local clone path per workspace.
Each phase carries its own status, notes and dates — the roadmap is per project, not global.
Not synced yet, so the numbers stay empty. Missing stats stay missing.
Sync checks existence, archive state, README, license, releases, freshness and the latest workflow run.
Illustrative rows — Vercel states appear when VERCEL_TOKEN is configured, and stay silent when it isn’t.
